title: Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan Voice Hindi Version of 'Obsession' for October 30 OTT Premiere
excerpt: Curry Barker's horror hit, which grossed over $500 million in theatres, premieres uncut on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar on October 30 at 7 p.m., with Sanon voicing Nikki and Dhawan voicing Bear in Hindi. The film's language is English, with a Hindi dubbed version.
body:
• Curry Barker's horror film Obsession premieres on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar on October 30 at 7 p.m. in its original uncut version, in English and Hindi.
  • Kriti Sanon voices Nikki and Varun Dhawan voices Bear in the Hindi version — the first time Sanon has lent her voice to another actor's performance.
  • The original film, starring Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, was released in Indian theatres on May 29, 2026 and grossed over $500 million globally.
  • The film is in English; the Hindi version is a dub. Theatrical viewers in India had complained about cut gore scenes — the OTT version is billed as uncut.

Following its run at the global box office, Curry Barker's Obsession is set to premiere on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar on October 30, with Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan lending their voices to the Hindi version. The film grossed over half a billion dollars globally, including a strong response in India, according to Filmfare.

Sanon voices Nikki and Dhawan voices Bear, the characters played on screen by Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston. The English version preserves the original performances; the Hindi adaptation gives the leads new interpretations by two of Bollywood's most recognisable voices. Sanon and Dhawan previously headlined Dilwale and Bhediya together.

"I absolutely loved the film and the performances in Obsession. It's such a gripping, quirky and twisted story. I've never explored a character this edgy before... This is also the first time I've lent my voice to another actor's performance."

— Kriti Sanon

"Working on the Hindi version of Obsession gave me an opportunity to experience the story from a completely different perspective. I noticed so many little details that I may have missed on a first watch."

— Varun Dhawan

The film and the story so far

Obsession, released in Indian theatres on May 29, 2026, mixes horror and romance: a young man makes a wish to an object that his longtime girlfriend end up loving him more than anything else in the world, the wish comes true, and the result is chaos and violence. It is a cautionary tale about male entitlement and the price of forcing love, also starring Cooper Tomlinson and Megan Lawless, according to Cinema Express. The film is among the ten highest-grossing horror films of all time on the figures reported at its theatrical run.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=w_Gs3_mqQog

Where to watch

The uncut versions premiere on October 30 at 7 p.m. on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar in India, in English and Hindi — timed for Halloween, and restoring the gore scenes whose cuts disappointed a section of the theatrical audience. The film had been available on a rental basis on Prime Video before this full digital premiere. For viewers in the US, this announcement is for the India service; check your local platform for the English original.
